scope: Design scenarios, not executed target tests

cases.name: identity_collision
cases.given: POS User 7 and Website User 7 share an email
cases.expected: Map to outlet and Website account separately; no credentials/roles merged

cases.name: customer_contact_match
cases.given: POS invoice and guest order have a registered customer email
cases.expected: No ownership link without verified source/account proof

cases.name: role_boundary
cases.given: Website manager attempts credential replacement or POS super-admin acts as Website owner
cases.expected: Deny without exact independent grant

cases.name: reset_realm
cases.given: Same email exists in POS admin and Website users; reset token is swapped
cases.expected: Only original broker/realm account may reset

cases.name: csrf_session
cases.given: Missing/expired CSRF, forged origin, reused session after password change
cases.expected: Reject; rotate/invalidate sessions and preserve realm isolation

cases.name: public_privacy
cases.given: Catalogue/account DTO includes cost,CNIC,secret or another customer data
cases.expected: Reject projection; public/private cache separation enforced

cases.name: product_link_collision
cases.given: Website external ID matches wrong outlet/category or no POS product
cases.expected: Quarantine/unpublish; never synthesize stock

cases.name: imei_reentry
cases.given: An IMEI sold historically is bought back; another active unit already claims it
cases.expected: Allow historical reuse only when no active owner; conflicting active claim fails

cases.name: last_quantity_race
cases.given: POS sale and Website checkout race for last quantity
cases.expected: Exactly one succeeds; no negative stock

cases.name: last_unit_race
cases.given: Two variants/requests reference one physical unit
cases.expected: One active allocation; complete IMEI slots and correct variant required

cases.name: price_change
cases.given: Price changes after cart display before checkout
cases.expected: Conflict with safe current price; no silent charge change

cases.name: mixed_outlet
cases.given: Physical checkout contains two outlets
cases.expected: 422; no partial reservations or orders

cases.name: idempotency_replay
cases.given: Same actor/key/payload repeated before/after response expiry
cases.expected: One durable operation and same resource, no duplicate sale/payment

cases.name: idempotency_conflict
cases.given: Same key with changed amount/lines or actor accesses another response
cases.expected: 409 or denied; no leaked replay

cases.name: confirm_expire_race
cases.given: Payment confirmation and expiry/release at deadline
cases.expected: One terminal reservation transition; late money preserved as reconciliation incident

cases.name: duplicate_callback
cases.given: Provider replays event or changes transaction/order/amount/currency
cases.expected: Matching replay harmless; mismatches rejected and audited

cases.name: late_payment
cases.given: Valid money receipt arrives after reservation release/cancellation
cases.expected: Preserve paid receipt, flag stock_exception, no unallocated sale

cases.name: unknown_provider_result
cases.given: Provider times out after receiving charge request
cases.expected: Reconcile persisted intent before new charge; no automatic duplicate

cases.name: cod_hold
cases.given: COD dispatch exceeds online TTL; another sale competes
cases.expected: Held COD stays unavailable; collection once; no unpaid completion

cases.name: disabled_provider
cases.given: Unconfigured gateway or browser paid=true payload
cases.expected: 503/422; no invented verification or card data storage

cases.name: quote_tampering
cases.given: Client supplies changed approved quote amount or stolen/expired token
cases.expected: Deny; server quote/version/ownership are authoritative

cases.name: return_duplicate
cases.given: Repeated receipt or quantity beyond original sale
cases.expected: At most one accepted return per unit; remaining-quantity cap

cases.name: refund_cap
cases.given: Concurrent refunds or unknown provider results exceed verified collected balance
cases.expected: Locked limit subtracts completed and pending/unknown refund intents; release only after verified failure; status alone never proves refund

cases.name: history_snapshot
cases.given: Business/theme/product/warranty/customer changes after sale
cases.expected: Original invoice/claim snapshot and identifiers remain unchanged

cases.name: revision_conflict
cases.given: Two editors publish same old revision; secret rotated before rollback
cases.expected: Stale publish rejected; no secret resurrection

cases.name: cache_after_commit
cases.given: Commit then crash before invalidation; Redis unavailable
cases.expected: Versioned master reads see committed state; checkout never trusts stale cache

cases.name: worker_retry
cases.given: Lease expires and same event is delivered twice/out of order
cases.expected: Deduplicate effects, reclaim safely, expose terminal failures

cases.name: decimal_rounding
cases.given: 0.10+0.20, residual discount allocation, overflow/exponent/more than 2 decimals
cases.expected: Exact 0.30 and deterministic totals; reject invalid representations

cases.name: source_import_rerun
cases.given: Same manifest rerun then changed source digest
cases.expected: No duplicate; changed input blocked pending reviewed run

cases.name: relationship_quarantine
cases.given: Missing FK/unknown column/invalid date/duplicate source alias
cases.expected: Quarantine with reconciled count; active obligations block promotion

cases.name: encrypted_recovery
cases.given: Missing/wrong/rotated key or tampered cipher/media manifest
cases.expected: Fail safely; providers disabled; no plaintext logging or empty-secret success

cases.name: post_write_rollback
cases.given: Failure after target accepted writes/provider receipt
cases.expected: Recover target journal; never redirect to stale source or sync writes back

cases.name: capability_scope
cases.given: Order-read token used to pay another quote or after revocation
cases.expected: Deny operation/resource mismatch and stale token; no referrer/log leak

cases.name: private_storage
cases.given: Traversal/SVG executable/upload or direct CNIC/backup URL
cases.expected: Reject unsafe upload; object-specific authorization required
